design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #08130D; --surface: #132219; --surface-alt: #203326; --text: #FFFDF1; --muted: #DADBC4; --primary: #84CC16; --accent: #38BDF8; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 0px; --gap: 32px; --blur: 16px; --nav-position: sticky; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; } .nav { position: var(--nav-position); z-index: 50; backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); border: 1px solid var(--border); } .nav a { color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; } .nav a:hover { color: var(--primary); } .hero::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 22%, transparent), transparent 34%); pointer-events: none; }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
